summary: Reviewed 41 units. Most important: (1) units 6 and 27: 'olpa' is not a print habit for 'alpa' but the dropped avagraha of śīto 'lpa / yukto 'lpa; śīta and yukta are separate words, flags and notes corrected, 27 had no flag; (2) unit 3: silent emendation hat->hṛd without flag; (3) unit 28: 'ruṇdhyāt' should be 'rundhyāt' (also in notes of 27); (4) unit 29: ādhmāna is neuter; (5) unit 35: Hindi 'हो' supplies a verb; (6) unit 24: the print has 17 syllables because of a doubled u-sign, 'dārutrikaṭukaṃ' (dāru + trikaṭuka) is metrically exact and the draft's suggested 'trikaṭūṣaka' is not a word; unit 15 also has 17 syllables (damage confirmed); (7) unit 34: 'saralāmaradārubhyāṃ' is closer in letters than the draft's guess; (8) sūrvā mis-tagged 'disputed' (unidentified); (9) minor Hindi/gloss/gram fixes. Identifications (bilva, trivṛt, yava, kulattha, pippalī, uśīra, vacā, nāgara, pathyā, palāśa, citraka, kuṣṭha, pīlu, sarṣapa, sauvarcala) look correct and suitably tagged; dāru/kola hedged properly; kattṛṇa and śaṭhī correctly marked disputed. Human decisions: 11 (madhyadoṣe), 16 (īritaḥ subject / saṃśeṣāmo), 20 (bhṛta vs śṛta), 24 (adopt dārutrikaṭukaṃ?), 2/3/15/34 remain low confidence. No regrouping needed; GROUPING notes are sensible.
glossary_suggestions: Print habit: a missing avagraha after -o (śīto'lpa, yukto'lpa) is printed as 'o' + consonant ('olpa'); split as two words, flag as 'avagraha dropped'.
rundhyāt (not ruṇdhyāt): √rudh class 7 optative has dental n; ṇ only in ruṇaddhi.
ādhmāna is neuter; śūla in compounds = 'pain' (not 'colic'); sūrvā = unidentified (not 'disputed').
Hindi: do not add 'हो/करे' modal verbs where the Sanskrit has none; do not add गति/उपाय nouns.
